Give one probability for at least one qualifying solution by each deadline; do not give separate probabilities for individual problems.

Probabilities must be numbers between 0 and 1 inclusive, nondecreasing with the deadline. Account for the possibility the event never occurs. Give your own best probability estimates despite uncertainty.
